domain: Virtual Keyboard & Sentence Typist (A-Z, Space, Del)

classes.label: A
classes.how_to_perform: Fist with thumb resting upright along the side of the index finger.

classes.label: B
classes.how_to_perform: Four fingers held upright together, thumb folded flat across palm.

classes.label: C
classes.how_to_perform: Curved hand forming a C-shape with all fingers and thumb.

classes.label: D
classes.how_to_perform: Index finger pointing straight up, other three fingers touching thumb tip.

classes.label: E
classes.how_to_perform: All four fingers curled tightly with tips resting on thumb.

classes.label: F
classes.how_to_perform: Index fingertip touches thumb tip forming an O, other three fingers upright.

classes.label: G
classes.how_to_perform: Index finger and thumb pointing horizontally forward in parallel.

classes.label: H
classes.how_to_perform: Index and middle fingers extended horizontally forward together.

classes.label: I
classes.how_to_perform: Little finger (pinky) pointing straight up, other fingers folded into fist.

classes.label: J
classes.how_to_perform: Pinky points up and traces a J-curve in the air.

classes.label: K
classes.how_to_perform: Index finger pointing up, middle finger angled forward, thumb between them.

classes.label: L
classes.how_to_perform: Index finger pointing up and thumb extended outward forming an L-shape.

classes.label: M
classes.how_to_perform: Fist with thumb tucked underneath the first three folded fingers.

classes.label: N
classes.how_to_perform: Fist with thumb tucked underneath the first two folded fingers.

classes.label: O
classes.how_to_perform: All fingertips touching thumb tip forming an O-shape circle.

classes.label: P
classes.how_to_perform: Like K but directed downward with middle finger pointing down.

classes.label: Q
classes.how_to_perform: Like G but directed downward toward floor.

classes.label: R
classes.how_to_perform: Index and middle fingers crossed over each other pointing upright.

classes.label: S
classes.how_to_perform: Tight fist with thumb folded horizontally across the front of fingers.

classes.label: T
classes.how_to_perform: Fist with thumb tucked between index and middle fingers.

classes.label: U
classes.how_to_perform: Index and middle fingers held straight up together in parallel.

classes.label: V
classes.how_to_perform: Index and middle fingers held straight up spread apart in a V-shape.

classes.label: W
classes.how_to_perform: Index, middle, and ring fingers held straight up spread apart like a W.

classes.label: X
classes.how_to_perform: Fist with index finger bent into a hook shape.

classes.label: Y
classes.how_to_perform: Thumb and pinky finger extended outward like a phone receiver.

classes.label: Z
classes.how_to_perform: Index finger traces a Z in the air.

classes.label: space
classes.how_to_perform: Open hand held flat moving sideways, inserting a space.

classes.label: del
classes.how_to_perform: Thumb and bent fingers flicking back, acting as a backspace/delete.

classes.label: nothing
classes.how_to_perform: Resting or neutral hand between letters.
